_comment: Copy this to accounts.json (GITIGNORED) to hold MULTIPLE API keys per search provider for the hub's <prefix>_account_* tools and its key rotation. Each 'account' is ONE API key. env values may be literal keys OR ${ENV} references resolved from the hub's environment at spawn time -- prefer ${ENV} refs so this file stays secret-free. Providers: exa (prefix ex, EXA_API_KEY), tavily (tv, TAVILY_API_KEY), firecrawl (fc, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY). You do NOT need this file for the common case: if a provider's primary key env (e.g. EXA_API_KEY) is present, the hub seeds a single 'default' key automatically, and any numbered backups you export (EXA_API_KEY_2, EXA_API_KEY_3, ...) are auto-registered as key2/key3 ${ENV} refs. Use this file only to pin literal keys or custom names. IMPORTANT: rotation is for PAID/legitimate multi-key setups -- on true exhaustion (HTTP 402) a key is cooled until the billing period resets; a 429 rate-limit is NOT rotated (Retry-After is honoured).
